question: Eco Farms Peru avocado oil company parent owner
markdown:
Eco Farms is majority-owned (65%) by the
The Oppenheimer Group (Oppy)
, which is owned by Dublin-based Total Produce. The remaining ownership is split between Eco Farms' founders and Santiago-based grower-marketer El Parque, which operates its Peruvian supply chain through
⁠Exportadora El Parque Peru SAC
in Lima.
